name: Hex Viewer
description: Inspect any file byte by byte, with search, go to offset and a data inspector
help: Open a file or drop it on the window. Files of any size open instantly; only the visible part is read. The file is never changed.
The file type is recognised from its first bytes (PNG, ZIP, PDF, ELF, Mach-O, SQLite and more).

Click a byte to move the cursor and Shift-click to select a range. Arrow keys, Page Up / Down and Home / End also move the cursor; hold Shift to select. ⌘ / Ctrl + Home / End jump to the start or end.
Go to accepts decimal numbers, hex such as 0x1F0 or 1F0h, and relative offsets such as +16 or -0x10.
Search for text or hex bytes such as DE AD BE EF. Enter finds the next match, Shift + Enter the previous one, and the search wraps around the file.

The data inspector reads the bytes at the cursor as integers, floats, binary, UTF-8 and Unix timestamps in little or big endian. The selection can be copied as hex, Base64, a C array, Python bytes or text.
